name: guardrails
description: Checks each Bash command before it runs. Blocks force-pushes to protected branches (main and master by default), git hooks skipped with --no-verify, and staging or committing files or added lines that look like secrets; requests confirmation before git commands that discard uncommitted work. It reads the command text, so it catches ordinary and accidental commands, not deliberately hidden ones. A skill explains each rule and its settings.
